answer: The raven schedule is applied in saffron and vault reveals each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4648 identities would post 1154 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
